title: Conductor run log
description: The append-only log bin/conduct.mjs keeps for one review round, lifecycle run or challenge. Run state is a pure function of it; the record is assembled from it. Commit it beside the record: it is the audit trail that each gate fired.

gate_answers.description: The operator's answers to one persona's gate questions (S10).

round.description: The author round that asked them.

provision.description: The outcome of one S11 provision attempt.

by.description: Peer route: the persona that supplied it.

note.description: What was supplied, verbatim, or why nothing was.

ranking.description: The conductor's top five, in rank order: only the scores. The script fills pull-quote, locator, final severity and convergence from the register and tally.

value.description: Risk reduced, friction removed, decisions unblocked.

constitutional_roi.description: Only when the addendum lists principles.

arbiter_note.description: An arbiter ruling that annotates this entry.

signoff.description: Review: the TL;DR and baseline (required). Lifecycle: the operator's sign-off ruling.

baseline_ref.description: The prior record this round baselines against.

secret_filter.description: Whether the filter ran over this run's memory writes; default not run.

incorporated.description: A self-heal incorporation done through speckit (S5).

skills.description: The speckit skills run, in order.

detail.description: What changed in the spec and what was regenerated.

operator_ruling.description: The operator's ruling on a gate's uncleared 🔴 at the bound (S7, D2).

disposition.description: waived lets the gate pass; open halts the run.

ruling_ref.description: Where the ruling lives. Required when any finding is waived.

local_ruling.description: Decision sink unbound: the ruling itself, kept in the ledger's local_rulings and cited as record "#".

schema_version.description: Schema version; the major must be 1.

header.description: What init fixed. Nothing here changes after init.

target.description: What is reviewed: a spec, PR, path or idea. The record's limits, so init refuses what record would.

dir.description: Where the record is written, from the repository root.

round_context.description: Review runs: the concrete since-last-chorus deltas. The record's limits.

feature.description: Lifecycle runs: the feature id, e.g. 018-scripted-spine.

corpus.description: Lifecycle and challenge runs: the artefacts each gate reviews.

roster.description: Who is asked to RSVP, in roster order.

bindings.description: The bindings block bin/bindings.mjs printed at init.

events.description: Append-only, in the order they happened.

type.description: reply: a validated persona reply. failure: a persona failed this step. ack: a free-form step done. answer: an agent or operator input.

phase.description: The phase the event belongs to.

round.description: The persona's ask within the phase: 2 for an RSVP re-ask, n+1 for a re-author after gate answers; need-info uses 1 for the author's revision and 2 for the re-vote. Absent means 1.

finding.description: need-info replies: the held finding they answer.

reason.description: failure: the validator's reason or what happened.

data.description: reply: the persona's JSON. answer: the input, validated against the fragment its topic fills.
